groups.operation: Release a parsed document through XMLNode descendant cleanup.
groups.condition: The parsed document has child nodes and is destroyed or cleared.
groups.capability: XMLNode must safely delete descendants through the relevant DeleteChildren/DeleteChild or DeleteNode path.
groups.consequence: Descendant cleanup may fail during document release.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same child-bearing document cleanup obligation and the same potential failure.

groups.operation: Call XMLDocument::DeleteNode with a null argument.
groups.condition: A caller passes null directly to XMLDocument::DeleteNode.
groups.capability: XMLDocument::DeleteNode must handle null before asserting about the node.
groups.consequence: The direct null call may trigger an assertion.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same direct null-argument operation, guard order, and assertion consequence.
